user.title: Automation Monitor
user.description: Detects failed automation runs and exposes them as a sensor. No configuration needed.

general.title: Automation Monitor options
general.description: How long an entity referenced by an automation or script must stay continuously unavailable before it's flagged, which labels exclude the automations/entities/devices carrying them from monitoring entirely (both sensors at once - for entity-only or automation-only settings, see the "Entities"/"Automations" menu items instead), whether to open a Repairs issue for each sensor (Settings -> Repairs, admin-only), how many consecutive failures an automation needs before it's flagged, and error messages that should never count as a failure at all (e.g. one specific flaky error you want to ignore, without excluding the whole automation).

data.excluded_labels: Excluded labels (automations/entities/devices, both sensors at once)
data.notify_failed_automations: Open a Repairs issue for failed automations
data.notify_linked_entities_unavailable: Open a Repairs issue for unavailable linked entities
data.failure_streak_threshold: Failure streak threshold (consecutive failures before flagging)
data.ignored_error_texts: Ignored error texts (a failure containing any of these is never flagged, type your own text)

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Entity-level settings: which entities to exclude entirely from the "Linked entities unavailable" sensor, and which entities need their own streak threshold (instead of the global default from General settings) for the "Failed automations" sensor. Streak-threshold values are entered on the next screen.

data.ignored_entities: Ignored entities (only affects the "Linked entities unavailable" sensor, never flagged)
data.streak_override_entities: Entities with an individual streak threshold

streak_overrides.title: Individual streak threshold
streak_overrides.description: Only the entities picked on the previous screen appear below - nothing else changes here. Each entity's own streak threshold: how many consecutive failures an automation touching this entity needs before it's flagged.

automations.title: Automations
automations.description: Automation-level settings: whether to skip currently turned-off automations when building the linked-entities reference map, and which automations need to be excluded from just one sensor instead of both (a label, General settings, always excludes from both). Exclusion values are entered on the next screen.

data.exclude_off_automations: Skip automations that are turned off

automation_exclusions.title: Automation exclusion
automation_exclusions.description: Only the automations picked on the previous screen appear below - nothing else changes here. For each: which sensor(s) it should be excluded from.
